summary: Credible Accounting is a five-person boutique accounting firm in Norwest, Sydney, founded in 2016 by Dev Punjani, offering bookkeeping, tax, payroll and fractional CFO services on fixed fees. Dev recently appeared on a small business podcast (Oct 2026) and the firm published a March 2026 article on its seven-point monthly reporting framework. LinkedIn shows 5 staff, up 75% YoY.

sources.title: The Numbers Don't Lie. Unless the Books Do.
Let's Talk Numbers, Clarity, and Small Business Growth with Dev Punjani
sources.publisher: Let's Talk small Business with Mitchell Wilson

claims.text: Credible Accounting is a boutique firm based in Norwest, Sydney, founded in 2016.
claims.quote: Based in Norwest Sydney, we are a boutique firm that works with clients across Australia.

claims.text: Dev Punjani is the founder and Director of Credible Accounting (current on LinkedIn).
LinkedIn lists Credible Accounting at 5 employees, up 75% year on year.
claims.quote: Credible Accounting employs 5 people (+75.0% YoY, +3 people), founded in 2016.

claims.text: Dev appeared on the Let's Talk small Business podcast (episode 56, October 2026).
claims.quote: Today's guest, Dev Punjani, founder and director of Credible Accounting

claims.text: On the podcast Dev said business owners' first mistake is coding transactions to the wrong ledger accounts, which makes decisions wrong.
claims.quote: business owners get wrong is the coding of the transactions, coding towards the general ledger accounts

claims.text: Dev said that when onboarding books, the first thing they do is clean them up and show a before-and-after picture.
claims.quote: when we onboard the books, we clean up the books

claims.text: Dev's firm began as bookkeeping for other accounting firms, which passed bookkeeping requirements to it.
claims.quote: we were basically passing on the bookkeeper's, uh, bookkeeping side of things or client requirements directly to us

claims.text: Credible's March 2026 article describes a seven-point monthly reporting framework including cashflow forecasting and KPIs.
claims.quote: Credible formalises this through a seven-point monthly reporting framework covering profit and loss, profit margins, budget analysis, KPIs, cashflow forecasting, and entity growth analysis.

claims.text: The same article says onboarding includes assembling two to three years of financial records and rectifying data misalignment in the accounting software.
claims.quote: rectifying the data misalignment in the accounting software

claims.text: The bookkeeping service reviews transaction coding for accuracy, not just reconciliation.
claims.quote: Transaction coding reviewed for accuracy, not just reconciliation

claims.text: The site claims 100% coding accuracy and 90% reduction in manual processing errors from a multi-entity services firm case.
Credible offers fractional CFO and finance function support, including KPI design and runway visibility.
claims.quote: Runway and burn rate visibility so timing decisions are made with full information

claims.text: They offer fixed-fee pricing and work with hospitality, start-ups and not-for-profits.
claims.quote: We work with hospitality, multi-national companies, start-ups, not-for-profit organisations, service industry and more.

hooks.text: Dev says wrong transaction coding is the first thing owners get wrong, and the firm sells coding accuracy. Vert's traceable cash coding matches that value.
Seven-point monthly reporting framework depends on timely reconciliation.
Team of 5 growing 75% YoY: capacity is the constraint.

risks.text: Already markets 'automation' and 100% coding accuracy on a client case, so may believe the problem is solved.
Already emailed twice (16 Nov and 23 Nov) with no reply logged.

gaps: No Xero/MYOB partner status or specific tools (Dext, Hubdoc) found.
